verdict.rationale: Restate's flow control lets you shape traffic with concurrency limits per scope. The docs explicitly frame this as a way to "keep scheduling fair" instead of letting invocations run unbounded, which plausibly covers tenant-level fairness when scopes map to tenants. Nothing in the evidence shows priorities that can be assigned to individual runs. missing for 10: per-run priority assignment, explicit multi-tenant fair-queuing semantics (e.g. weighted or round-robin across tenants), detailed scheduling docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
